info.name: Hermes Gateway API Collection - SA
info.description:
Postman collection for the Hermes Agent Gateway API Server (Hermes Agent v0.19.0 (2026.7.20), upstream 8c36cd46, profile `system-analyst`).

Base URL: http://HOST:8643
Auth: Bearer token using API_SERVER_KEY

Generated from HERMES_GATEWAY_API_COLLECTION.md (generated at 2026-07-29T09:30:34+00:00).

Set the collection variables HERMES_BASE_URL and HERMES_API_KEY before running requests. Always re-verify against GET /v1/capabilities after a Hermes upgrade, since this document describes only the currently installed gateway's API surface, not a generic promise for every release.

item.name: 2. Session Resources

request.description:
List persisted sessions.

Query parameters:
- limit: default 50, max 200
- offset: default 0, max 1,000,000
- source: optional source filter
- include_children: include forked child sessions (default false)

body.raw:
{
  "id": "sa-analysis-001",
  "title": "Requirement Analysis",
  "source": "eksad-portal",
  "model": "system-analyst",
  "system_prompt": "Focus on technical requirement analysis and EKSAD architecture standards."
}

request.description: Get session metadata.
Update title or end reason. Only `title` and `end_reason` are accepted.
Delete session.
Get persisted session messages.
Fork session with existing transcript. The child session receives the existing transcript and references the source session as its parent.
Session chat with a single inline Base64 image. Base64 encoding increases request size (limit 10,000,000 bytes); prefer an HTTP/HTTPS object-storage URL for large images.
Session chat with multiple image_url parts referencing hosted images.

item.name: Session Chat - Text + Images + Extracted DOCX Text (Recommended Multi-Artifact Pattern)

request.description: Hermes has NO native file upload / Files API and rejects `input_file`/`file_id` content (HTTP 400 `unsupported_content_type`). This is the recommended production pattern: the application extracts DOCX/PDF text itself and sends it as plain text alongside image_url parts, since Hermes only officially accepts text and images inline.

Execute one turn and stream SSE events (text/event-stream). Event names can include message deltas, tool progress, final completion, error, and approval-related lifecycle events.

In Postman, disable response redirects and inspect the raw stream, or use a client that supports SSE.
Persist and acknowledge a model/provider lock. Use this when a client must persist an explicit provider/model runtime selection.

item.description: Persistent Hermes sessions: CRUD, forking, synchronous/streaming chat, model lock, and multimodal chat patterns (images, extracted DOCX text).

item.name: 5. Asynchronous Agent Runs

request.description:
Start an agent run and immediately return a run_id (HTTP 202 Accepted).

Example response:
```json
{
  "run_id": "run_1234567890abcdef",
  "status": "started"
}
```

Accepts `conversation_history` as an array of {role, content} objects. If both `conversation_history` and `previous_response_id` are supplied, explicit `conversation_history` wins.

Poll run status.

Typical statuses: queued, running, waiting_for_approval, completed, failed, stopping, cancelled.

Stream run lifecycle and tool events via SSE.

Typical events: message.delta, approval.request, approval.responded, run.completed, run.failed, run.cancelled. Tool-progress events may also be emitted by the active agent.
Resolve a pending dangerous-command approval. Allowed choices: once, session, always, deny. Aliases approve, approved, and allow map to once.
Interrupt an active run.

item.description: /v1/runs — start long-running agent turns without blocking the HTTP request, poll status, stream lifecycle events, resolve approvals, and stop runs.

item.name: 6. Cron Jobs

request.description:
List cron jobs.

Note: routes are installed and operational, but the stable /v1/capabilities payload currently reports jobs_admin: false. Treat these routes as operational/version-sensitive rather than a permanent public compatibility contract.

Create cron job. Required fields: name, schedule. Max name length 200 chars; max prompt length 5,000 chars.

Supported schedule examples:
30m
every 2h
0 9 * * *
2026-08-01T09:00:00+07:00
Get one cron job. Job IDs must match 12 lowercase hexadecimal characters.
Update cron job. Allowed fields: name, schedule, prompt, deliver, skills, skill, repeat, enabled.
Pause cron job.
Resume cron job.
Trigger immediate execution.
Delete cron job.

item.description: /api/jobs — schedule, manage, pause/resume, and manually trigger cron-based agent jobs. Operational but version-sensitive (jobs_admin capability flag is currently false).
